header.headline: An engineering company building sovereign AI security
header.subhead: Sibernetick is developed by a team that treats evidence, deployment boundaries, and honest labelling as product requirements — not marketing.

profile.title: Corporate profile

facts.value: Sibernetick — data-sovereign, AI-native enterprise cybersecurity platform
Lab-validated prototype (lab environment, source: product i18n/observatory, 2026-06)

profile.body: We build for institutions that cannot compromise on where their data lives. That constraint shapes the architecture: local intelligence, orchestrated agents, and a human approval gate on every change. We publish what the lab has shown and label the rest as roadmap.

press.title: For press
bullets: Product facts and labelling guidance live in the metrics registry (/metrics).
Please preserve status labels: lab-validated, prototype, roadmap, early access.
No competitive claims are authorised beyond published, sourced material.

investors.title: For investors
bullets: Wedge: sovereign deployment where cloud-only AI security is structurally blocked.
Moat: orchestration tuned to regulated environments plus published evidence discipline.
Business model: proprietary product under commercial agreement; open landing builds trust and distribution.
Narrative with no invented numbers: /metrics → investor narrative.

developers.title: For developers & entrepreneurs
bullets: Landing repo is dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0 — fork, adapt, ship.
Good first issues: locale, animation, SEO, case studies.
Product integration and early access are handled through contact, not self-serve (for now).
